method: Independent current direct SEC HTTP byte capture with redirects, status, media type, byte count and SHA-256; claim-level review of the current filed S-4, Ridgewood observer agreement, merger agreement and Greenbacker Form 10-Q

verifiedClaims: The filed S-4 identifies MN8 Energy LLC as a Delaware limited liability company formed on 2017-09-19 and formerly known as Goldman Sachs Renewable Power LLC

The filing describes the March 2024 Holdings reorganization and Series A preferred issuance, identifies WSI Fund II Holdings, LP and Mercuria Clean Energy Investments BV as preferred holders and reports approximately 1,370 separate common holders at merger signing

The filing identifies Goldman Sachs Asset Management, the Regents of the University of California, WSI and Mercuria as consent parties and supplies future-closing unit allocations, but it does not publish a complete cutoff-current named member and transfer register for all common holders

The filing states that WSI is controlled through Ridgewood Water & Strategic Infrastructure Fund II and its parallel fund and that Mercuria Clean Energy Investments BV is indirectly wholly owned by Mercuria Energy Group Limited

The filing reports approximately 870 projects in 29 states, approximately 3.9 GW of operating and under-construction solar, approximately 440 MW of operating and under-construction battery storage and more than 200 enterprise customers as of 2026-03-31

The filing describes the signed Greenbacker merger, future cash, unit or mixed elections, proration, conversion or exchange of existing MN8 interests and conditions; it does not prove that the merger closed by the cutoff
The filed observer agreement is effective 2024-03-28 and identifies WSI Fund II Holdings, LP f/k/a MN8 Fund II Holdings, L.P. as the Ridgewood investor member

The agreement recites that WSI's purchased preferred units represented less than 10% of MN8 Energy equity on an as-converted basis at entry and provides a non-voting observer right subject to a 25% retention condition
The agreement does not provide a cutoff-current percentage or establish company control

The filed merger agreement is dated 2026-07-21 and identifies Greenbacker Renewable Energy Company LLC, MN8 Energy Holdings LLC, MN8 Energy LLC, Monarch Merger Sub, LLC and Shareholder Representative Services LLC as parties

The agreement provides for Monarch Merger Sub to merge into Greenbacker, with Greenbacker surviving, and for holders to receive cash, MN8 units or mixed consideration subject to elections and proration
The agreement states future closing conditions and does not itself establish legal completion, final holder elections, final proration, funds flow or a post-close MN8 register
Greenbacker's filed Q2 2026 Form 10-Q says it entered into a proposed merger with MN8 and affiliated entities on 2026-07-21
The filing says the transaction was expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026 subject to shareholder, member and other closing conditions
The filing is pending-status evidence and does not establish legal close, final consideration elections, incoming MN8 holders or post-close stakes
